sentences.en: Sami pays his co-workers to work his shifts for him.
sentences.zh: 1. 萨米付钱给他的同事，请他们替他上班。

sentences.en: He works really hard, and his co-workers respect him for it.
sentences.zh: 2. 他工作非常努力，因此同事们都很尊敬他。

sentences.en: Some of your co-workers are very active at night.
sentences.zh: 3. 你们的一些同事晚上很活跃。

senses.zh: 共同工作者，合作者，同事，帮手
